original_test_intent: Validate all eight UBB GPU power channels across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence against the approved GPU power specification.
original_method: The platform and power owners expand eight exact names, bind UBB GPU0 through GPU7 to stable physical and software identities, define the measured electrical boundary and state-qualified limits, and automation performs passive collection.
manual_activity: The platform and power owners define the eight-sensor population, map every zero-based UBB index to stable GPU identity, approve the telemetry boundary and state-qualified power limits, then review all evidence.
required_inputs: Exact PWR_UBB_GPU0 through PWR_UBB_GPU7 names and fitted population
Per-index UBB slot/module plus GPU serial, UUID and PCI BDF mapping
Definition of UBB and authoritative telemetry producer such as BMC ADC, PMBus controller or another source
Measurement boundary: board or slot input, GPU module, ASIC, rail aggregate or another defined quantity
Units, scale, sign, resolution, averaging or integration window, refresh, stale and not-present semantics
Expected ranges by GPU power state, approved workload state, cooling mode, inlet temperature and platform power policy
Relationship to passive AMDGPU telemetry and permitted comparison tolerance without treating it as substitute coverage
SDR entity/name/description plus Sensor List/Web mapping and same-target BMC/GPU/spec revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent power, cooling, GPU and BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve eight exact names; the endpoint range is not an executable sensor identity
Treat the parenthetical AMDGPU text as a tooling hint only after owner approval, not part of the sensor filter or acceptance
Bind each zero-based index to stable hardware and software identity; do not rely on enumeration order alone
Compare only telemetry with an owner-proven common electrical boundary, time window and state
Do not induce workload, reload drivers, reset GPUs, alter power controls or thresholds, write BMC state or clear logs
Stop on missing, stale, negative or implausible power, identity drift, GPU fault, thermal/power anomaly or incomplete views
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source, exact eight-name expansion, fitted population and stable GPU map
Verify telemetry producer/boundary, units, timing semantics and approved state-qualified limits
Collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, eight exact sensor results and BMC Web
Collect passive GPU inventory and AMDGPU power evidence only as owner-approved supporting correlation
Perform no workload, driver reload, GPU reset, power/threshold/BMC/log mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve UBB GPU0-GPU7 population and stable slot/module/serial/UUID/BDF mapping
Define the sensor producer and exact electrical power boundary
Approve units, timing semantics, state-qualified limits and any cross-telemetry comparison tolerance
Review all eight channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use eight owner-approved exact sensor names, collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR/Sensor List plus Web, and correlate with stable GPU identity and passive state context.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES EIGHT-CHANNEL UBB IDENTITY MAP, POWER-BOUNDARY CONTRACT AND STATE-QUALIFIED LIMITS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an eight-row map from exact BMC sensor to UBB slot/module and GPU serial/UUID/BDF, record telemetry producer and boundary, then reconcile complete views under a captured passive power state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes electrical boundary and identity explicit instead of equating a name substring or enumeration index with a physical GPU and power quantity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Passive AMDGPU telemetry can support diagnosis only when its boundary and time window are understood; it does not replace any BMC UBB sensor or Web view.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A BMC or PMBus input-side reading may include conversion and board losses while AMDGPU reports ASIC or module power. Numerically comparing them without boundary and timing definitions can produce a false failure or conceal a missing rail.

project_override_considerations: If GPU indices change after firmware, driver or topology changes, evidence must use stable serial/UUID/BDF and slot identity. Unfitted indices require explicit not-present behavior and must not be silently omitted.
expected_evidence: Approved exact eight-name/fitted-population list and zero-based UBB index map
Per-GPU slot/module/serial/UUID/BDF identity and same-target proof
Telemetry producer, electrical boundary, units, scale, timing, freshness and state-qualified power criteria
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus eight exact sensor results
BMC Web and passive GPU inventory/health/state evidence; AMDGPU power only as approved supporting correlation
No-workload/no-driver-reload/no-GPU-reset/no-power-control/no-threshold/no-BMC-write/no-clear audit, statuses, hashes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The AMDGPU parenthetical is ambiguous formatting but does not contradict the consistent eight-channel UBB GPU power intent; it requires owner interpretation before use.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive eight-channel power review is identifiable after the owner supplies stable GPU mapping, measurement boundary and state-qualified criteria under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Adds a zero-based stable GPU identity map and separates BMC/PMBus input-side telemetry from potentially different AMDGPU ASIC or module telemetry.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU0-GPU7 enumeration can move across firmware and driver states, and two power interfaces can measure different electrical boundaries and aggregation windows. Stable hardware identity plus a boundary-specific acceptance envelope is required before any numeric comparison has engineering meaning.
